title: Transaction Script

Domain Model and Table Module establish alternative organizations of logic. Stafford’s Service Layer defines the separate application boundary. Official SQLite and Python documentation support the chosen local transaction mechanism. The warehouse scenario, executable code, and native SVGs are original teaching material. No Table Module article or other candidate stub was created.

example_limits: Python 3.10+ and standard-library SQLite. One SKU per request, with whole-unit counts and exact opaque identifiers. The caller owns an idle explicit-transaction connection and its closing; the procedure owns the local transaction and its rules. The demo database is in memory. No physical dispatch, authentication, reservations, cancellation, durable idempotency outcome protocol, automatic contention retry, or cross-database coordination is implemented. Duplicate IDs reject rather than return the original outcome. Remaining units are the committed result of this operation, not a promise about later availability. BEGIN IMMEDIATE supplies the demonstrated concurrency mechanism; the pattern name does not create atomicity or locking.
publication: Local implementation only. No publishing, deployment, push, or pull request.
